programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Potatoes are one of the crops most essential in Korean cuisine. It can be cooked and enjoyed in various ways and depending on each season, as in the form of a simple side dish, soup, or entree. We give you two different versions of potato pancake recipes, either serving as a perfect snack to munch on for adults enjoying a glass of drink or as an afternoon snack for children.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Yaksik has been long-adored as Korea's traditional snack made with glutinous rice mixed with various ingredients like chestnuts, pine nuts, and jujubes. Because isn't too overloaded with strong flavors, it is regarded even as a great meal replacement for people craving something light. Known for its chewy texture and sweet taste, it is commonly served at festivities.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Because many of the potato dishes that we enjoy are either steamed or pan-fried, they boast a rather smooth texture. But Gamja Ongshimi, a local dish that originated in Korea's Gangwon-do Province, is known for the chewiness that fills the whole mouth, as it consists of small rice-cake-shaped balls made with finely-shredded potatoes. Here's a recipe for gamja ongshimi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mackerel is one of the most popular blue-backed fish rich in nutrients. While it's great to be enjoyed as it is, it's also great to braise it with sweet radish using a sweet and spicy marinade. That way, the fishy smell can be easily removed while becoming more flavorful. Here's a recipe for braised mackerel with radish that will get you easily devouring a bowl of rice.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gamja Gang Doenjang Ssambap is one of the most common dishes that Koreans enjoy as a meal. While freshwater snails are primarily used in making the soupy dish, the mollusks can be replaced with potatoes for a softer and more savory taste. We give you a thorough recipe for Gamja Gang Doenjang Ssambap made with fresh potatoes harvested this autumn.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: March 1st this year marks the 104th anniversary of the nationwide movement to restore Korea's independence during Japan's colonial rule. It's the day we all remember and honor countless independence activists who had put their lives on the line for the nation's liberation. Here are the two dishes that relieved their hunger amid the difficult and unsettling times.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Tteokgalbi boasts a long tradition and history from when it was first made in the kitchens of royal palaces to the present day, where it is commonly enjoyed by many people in the nation. Known for its sweet and savory flavor, many people misunderstand it as a quite challenging dish to make themselves. Here's a simple and quick recipe to make tasty tteokgalbi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: One of the best ways to enjoy pollack in the cold winter is by eating it after repeated freezing and thawing the fish. As the fish undergoes this process, it becomes soft and flavorful, which is why many people love to have it as part of their meals. Here's a way to reinvigorate your appetite with grilled dried pollack!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jeyukbokkeum is one of the most common Korean pork dishes that are stir-fried with a spicy sauce made with chili powder and paste. Especially popular among those who are fond of enjoying spicy foods, where and how does the dish attain its unique fire flavors? Here's a recipe for jeyukbokkeum that will get your taste buds addicted to its spiciness.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gimjang season is an important time that comes around every November as families get together to make kimchi at home. Suyuk is a dish commonly enjoyed alongside the kimchi just made on the day of gimjang. It's sliced pork, usually made with pork belly after fully cooked in boiling water. The soft texture of the meat goes superbly well with the crunchiness of the fresh and refreshing kimchi!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Baekseolgi is a steamed rice cake made that boasts a chewy texture. The white color of the rice cake is emblematic of pure and clean food, making it a proper dish to be served on a child's 100th day after birth. The non-glutinous rice powder is used to make a chewy and savory rice cake. Here's a recipe to make baekseolgi at home!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Donkatsu is a dish that is widely enjoyed by just about everyone! The Korean version of donkatsu, in particular, which comes in the flatter and thinner version of pork battered in flour, is casually eaten at home and in restaurants. Having been introduced originally from Japan, let's check out how to make the Korean pork cutlet with its unique taste and shape.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mandu is a juicy little bag of goodness filled with ground meat and chopped vegetables, symbolizing good fortune for its look! They are also high in nutrition and full of meat and vegetables. Here's how to make mandu that cannot be missed out on holiday!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Every Korean's favorite side dish, jangjorim. While it's commonly made with beef, it's also delicious when made with pork with a chewy texture! Here's a recipe that will help you easily make pork jangjorim.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gimbap is a colorful bite of delicious ingredients wrapped and rolled in a sheet of laver! It's considered a convenient dish that can be enjoyed on the go that's also rich in nutrition from vegetables and seaweed. Here's an easy recipe to make one yourself!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gujung ttteokboki was traditionally enjoyed by the kings during the Joseon Dynasty! Contrary to normal tteokboki smothered in red chili paste, it is based on soy sauce, which gives its distinctive sweet and savory taste. It's also high in nutritious values, making it a perfect option for a meal. Here's how to easily make gungjung tteokboki that everyone would love!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mulhoe is a common dish full of seafood that many people love regardless of the season! It has a sweet, tangy, and savory medley of flavors and textures in a bowl full of cold broth. Here's how to make one yourself at home with ease.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gyeranmari is an egg omelet roll pan-fried with various ingredients! It's one of the most casually enjoyed side dishes by Koreans. Learn the recipe to make one yourself, using the ingredients of your choice!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Cod is one of the best kinds of fish to enjoy during the wintertime. It can be made into a hearty soup that warms you up with its flavorful broth and chewy meat. Here's a recipe for the cod fish soup that will help you get through the blistering cold.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: There's nothing like an icy cold beer on a hot summer day. Pair it with sausage yachae bokkeum, stir-fried sausages and vegetables and dakgangjeong, crispy fried chicken tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: It's a universal custom to enjoy delicious traditional dishes and wish for wellness and good fortune on New Year's day. In Korea, people enjoy tteokguk to wish for longevity and wealth. Marking New Year's, a new chef tells us a recipe to make tteokguk.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Galbijjim is one of the go-to dishes for family gatherings or celebrations! Whether it be made with beef ribs or pork ribs, the dish boasts a uniquely sweet flavor from the soy sauce-based marinade and a tender texture! Here's a recipe for a delicious pork galbijjim that will get you to kickstart the new year on a strong note!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jeon is one of the staples that make Korean holidays complete. From the zucchini pancakes made with zucchini slices battered in flour and egg to soft and nutty dongtae jeon made with frozen pollock fillets, and last but not least, the colorful and tasty pancake skewers, here are all the easy recipes to make these for this new year!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: The first two K-food recipes Chef Ryan will share with us are bossam and geotjeori, or thinly sliced boiled pork wrapped in napa cabbage leaves with freshly made kimchi. Learn how to make the soft and juicy pork meat infused with fresh aromatics and refreshing tangy kimchi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Kimchi can add a spicy kick to the original Mexican quesadilla recipe. Kimchi quesadilla offers a flavor-packed blend of tangy kimchi and rich cheese. Pair it with a warm salad made with sweet and soft small napa cabbage and savory bacon bits for a fusion brunch.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A tofu steak is a great recipe to incorporate vegetables into children's diet. Made from a variety of vegetables and tofu, the dish both satisfies children's picky palates and provides the nutrition they need. Try crispy sweet potato sticks for a healthy and delicious dessert.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Street toast can be easily seen at food stands located near either a subway station or a bus stop! Filled with various ingredients, including eggs, cabbages, cheese, and others between two slices of toasted bread, it's both filling and satisfying to have as a meal or a snack! Here's how to make K-toast which has apparently become a very popular item in the UK!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chuseok is one of the biggest holidays in Korea when families gather around to celebrate the good harvest with special food. One of the Chuseok staples is songpyeon which is a half-moon shaped steamed rice cake stuffed with various fillings, such as soybeans, sesame seeds and chestnuts. Another dessert to enjoy on Chuseok is nut gangjeong, packed with walnuts, pine nuts and dried dates.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Steamed egg can never be left out when it comes to egg dishes! Boiling in a ttukbaegi, the steamed egg stays warm for a long time. Good as a side dish or with drinks, steamed egg has a wonderful moist and soft texture! Check out the recipe for steamed egg, loved by people of all ages!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: In Korea, there is nothing like haemul pajeon, or seafood green onion pancake, on a rainy day. Chef Ryan shares with us how to make this delicious pancake made from a flour-based batter with green onions and a variety of seafood. Pair it with a dipping sauce made with dallae (wild mountain chives), dill or any other fresh spring herb available in your area.

programme.title: Karen Rontowski
programme.desc: Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world. Her stand- up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator and Reiki master. From fun with her family to her travels all over this great country Karen has fun where ever she goes. Her lighthearted confusion entertains kids of all ages. She is fascinated with the “afterlife” is convinced she will someday have a near death experience because, “I never finish anything.” She explains, “Sometimes a ghost will just do the same thing over and over in life. That's why I want to move into a house that is haunted by a maid." Karen's comedy is now featured in the new line of greeting cards called “Frank and Funny” sold at Target stores everywhere and is the comedy writer for “Haunted Magazine.” She is a regular on the Bob and Tom Radio Show and is a featured performer on their CD. Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham and Comedy Central. She has opened for show biz legends including Bob Hope, Ray Charles, David Brenner and the Monkees.

programme.title: Bengt Washburn
programme.desc: Bengt Washburn is an Aquarius with Hazel eyes who prefers boxer briefs, solid deodorants, and Crest toothpaste. He is 5'9? tall, weighs about 149 pounds and can bench 150 pounds three times without a spotter. He has a vertical leap of 16 inches. 8 years ago a lump appeared on his right thigh. It's not visible from the stage but according to some kids at the water park, it looks creepy. Many people say Bengt looks kind of like a monkey. Bengt Washburn was born in Salt Lake City, Utah but grew up in a large Utah town (1,200 people) as the fifth child in a small Mormon family (7 children). Bengt is married to an officer in the United States Airforce. They have lived in 6 different cities over the last eleven years. Most recently he moved to Springfield, Virginia (Washington D.C.) after living in Stuttgart, Germany for 3 years. Bengt is a former winner of the prestigious San Francisco International Comedy Competition. He has been seen on The Late Late Show with Craig Fergusen, Live at Gotham on Comedy Central and most recently Conan on TBS. He was invited to perform at the Vancouver International Comedy Festival, The Boston Comedy Festival, the Aspen Laff Festival and Gilda's Laugh Fest in Grand Rapids, Michigan. He's been heard on NPR, PRI and Bob and Tom. All three of his comedy Cd's can be heard playing on XM Sirius radio. Most people who know him would say Bengt is a logistically impaired ditz, but his comedy is described as intelligent, surprisingly universal considering the content matter and profoundly funny.

programme.title: Paul Morrissey
programme.desc: Paul was raised as a sports fanatic in the tiny town of Owego, in upstate New York. After four years of playing college basketball, somehow he graduated. Aside from playing in the NBA, his dream job was to talk about sports for a living. Paul then moved to California after landing a television sports anchor job but found out quickly that he was “too much of a smart-ass” for TV news. After he was fired, Paul took his unique sense of humor to comedy club stages all over the country. In 2005, Paul was selected to perform at the HBO Comedy Festival in Las Vegas. Morrissey has also been a finalist in several national comedy competitions including Wendy's Comedy Challenge, Comedy Central's Open Mic Fight and Maxim's Real Men of Comedy.

programme.title: Key Lewis
programme.sub-title: Half Black, Half White, Looks Mexican
programme.desc: Sacramento California born Key Lewis is a high energy, improvisational, storytelling, multiple-personality nutcase! His love for the people and hunger for the stage is his undying motivation. His comedic stories about his interracial childhood, family, and unusual views on relationships, make Key simply a joy to watch. His ability to improvise and interact with all types of crowds makes this up and coming comic and actor one to look out for. Key Lewis has appeared on Marlon Wayans TBSís Funniest Wins, Starz Networks StaannDup, Kevin Harts One Mic Stand as well as Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes! Key says, chase your dream, always know your audience donít act funny, be funny... donít worry about the quantity of your material but the quality the sooner you create a relationship with your crowd, the better you will be. Television: Bill Bellamyís Whoís Got Jokes on TVONE. BETíS One Mic Stand Hosted by Kevin Hart. Starz Network Comedy Series called StaannDup, Marlon Wayanís TBSís Funniest Wins! Competitions: Winner of the 2013 Rocky Mountain Laugh Off, Finalist in the 2010 Bay Area Black Comedy Competition, Semi-Finalist 2009 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, a Semi-Finalist in the 2008 Boston Comedy Festival, 2007 Seattle International Comedy Competition Finalist, Shades of Laughs Portland Oregon Winner, TVONE Bill Bellamyís Who Got Jokeís Contestant. Radio: Improv work with FM Morning Shows (Top 40 Radio): KSFM 102.5 (Sacramento, CA), KWOD 106.5 (Sacramento, CA) KWIN 97.7 ñ Stockton/Lodi, CA, Mix 107.9 Salt Lake City UT (Is It Racist Segment) & The Man Panel. Concerts/Festivals: Opened for Jon B. and Keysha Cole, Taste Of Tacoma, & Bite Of Seattle Fountain Stage 5 Years Running! Key Lewis has worked with the likes of Kevin Hart, Pablo Francisco, Sam Bam, Alonzo Bodden, Jay London, Gabriel Iglesias, Brooks McBeth, Tommy Davidson, Katt Williams, De-Ray Davis, Andrew Norelli, Lonnie Love, Jeff Garcia, Damon Wayans, Joey Diaz, Guy Torry, Darren Carter, Paul Mooney, Kermet Apio and many more.

programme.title: Tom Clark
programme.desc: Tom Clark was born and raised, in that order. Clark's mix of well-crafted jokes and spontaneous crowd work has led to appearances on TBS's ‘Conan,' CBS's ‘Late Late Show, and Comedy Central's ‘Premium Blend'. Clark has traveled coast to coast doing stand up and has performed internationally as part of New Faces at the prestigious‘Just For Laughs Comedy Festival' in Montreal and on The Main Stage at ‘The Capetown Comedy Festival' in South Africa. Clark is also an actor and has appeared on such shows as NBC's ‘Outsourced', TNT's ‘The Closer',and the Hallmark made for TV movie ‘The Wish List'. After landing the role on ‘Outsourced,' director Ken Kwapis invited Clark to be in the Drew Barrymore movie, ‘Big Miracle'. You can also see Clark in Columbia Pictures ‘Freaks of Nature.'

programme.title: BT
programme.sub-title: My Life As I Know It Now
programme.desc: With an act that crosses all boundaries, B.T. will surely have you rolling with laughter. His physical performance style and charm landed him two performances on NBC's Friday Night Videos and a performance at the prestigious HBO U.S. Comedy Arts Festival. B.T. has also appeared on BET's Comic View, MTV's The Jenny McCarthy Show, and FOX's The Keenan Ivory Wayans Show.

programme.title: Johnny Beehner
programme.desc: Johnny Beehner puts on a funny show. He's got everything you want from a comic: He's silly, he's likeable, and he's fun. With a background in improvisational theater including training at Chicago's prestigious Second City, as well as the Upright Citizens Brigade in Los Angeles, Johnny brings a unique style to the stage. Beehner made his network television debut in January of 2015 as one of the last comedians to appear on the Late Show with David Letterman. He has made numerous appearances on FOX "Laughs" television show, and regularly appears on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Show. His comedy can be heard regularly on XM/ Sirius Satellite radio. Other notable and accomplishments of Johnny's include winning First place in Comcast's 2014 season of "Trial By Laughter," placing third in the 2014 “Laughing Skull Comedy Festival” of Atlanta, and making it to the finals in the 2012 “Great American Comedy Festival”. He was named one of Ricky Gervais' Top 5 picks in the "Just Sayin” stand up contest. Johnny was recently named one of 2015's Top10, "Hot Comics to Watch" by his wife. She says that he would have a shot at the #1 spot if he would “work just a little bit harder”. He's a married man, a new dad, and his current life goal is to win just one argument with his beautiful wife.

programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off!

programme.title: The Book Of Obsession
programme.desc: The Knights are tasked with protecting the King's valuable Ned Knights comic book during the Bookingheim Knight-a-Con. But with all the costumed kids there, will they recognize the real Jestro and Book of Monsters coming to get them? King Halbert instructs the Knights that they must take his valuable Ned Knights comic book to the “Knight-a-Kon” in Bookingham. It will be the first be first prize at the Knight-a-Kon. But the Book of Monsters wants the book, too. Having devoured Ned Knightly comic books in it's down time it has become fanatically obsessed with the storyline. General Magmar suggests they simply attack the place and take what they want, but Jestro tells them they can't: everyone will be in costume and they'll be thousands of comics there. This calls for a clever “infiltration” mission (which will also allow Jestro to see the Kon, which he's always wanted to do.) So Jestro goes into the Kon with the BOM and some monsters. And it's easy because everyone is in costume Jestro, the BOM and their monsters fit right in at the convention and Clay and crew have their work cut out for them trying to separate fiend from fan. Macy keeps going on-and-on about the story in the King's comic book as the Knights keep a watchful eye on it. Robin even shows up in the “Minitrex” – a small version of the Fortrex he built just for the Knight-a-Kon. He's convinced he can win the costume competition that is the big closing event for the Kon. At the end of the Kon there's a big awards ceremony for “Best Costume.” The prize: “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1.” The BOM must get it and scheme to get closer to it during the costume contest. He's just…about…to get the book when…the impatient Magmar attacks! Everyone thinks it's part of the big show! “Ned Knightly, Knight of Knighton, Issue #1” is tossed from person-to-person-to-person in the melee. The Knights must do something, but they're too far away from the Fortrex to download any NEXO-Power. Robin pulls up in his Minitrex they can use it to get NEXO-Power! Robin wins the best costume for his Minitrex and wins the Ned Knightly Comic which he then gives to Macy…she deserves to read it.

But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community. Plum suggests that she teach music lessons Plum has always wanted to learn the drums, as it would enhance her ability to give dance lessons with live rhythmic accompaniment.

programme.title: Link into the VRAINS
programme.desc: n Den City, duels are held in the highly advanced VR world Link VRAINS, which is always under attack by the Knights of Hanoi. However, a hero named Playmaker has arrived to face the Knights, capturing a program they want called an Ignis.

programme.title: Seize the Wind!
programme.desc: Playmaker continues his duel with the Knight of Hanoi using the new Speed Duel rules. Playmaker is backed into a corner by the Knight's Cracking Dragon, but a data storm soon envelopes the field and Playmaker activates his Skill.

programme.title: Top Talent
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival. Strawberry and Cherry are going to sing a duet, Orange is going to juggle, Plum will perform a ballet, Blueberry is writing and directing a play that the Berrykins will perform, Lemon will design animal-shaped hairstyles and display them herself, Princess Berrykin is going to yodel, and Berrykin Bloom will to do a stand-up comedy routine. Raspberry, who was the big star of the music recital (with only nine mistakes), is going to perform her same keyboard piece.

programme.title: No Blueberry Is an Island
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does, so they can prepare accordingly—they see Strawberry wearing a diving mask and snorkel in the cafe, and race to the lake to practice scuba diving, not knowing she was only slicing onions.

programme.title: Where the Berry Breeze Blows
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here! She insists they can build a copy of “Berry Breezy Bay” resort on Berry Bitty Lake, a duplicate down to the last detail.

programme.title: Sid's Rainy Day Play Date
programme.desc: Sid isn't too happy and wonders if the rain knew he wanted to play outside? At school, Sid and his friends discover that rain actually comes from rain clouds! They also learn that rain is really important because it helps living things grow.

programme.title: Special Sunny Dad Day
programme.desc: At school, Sid and his friends discover that sunblock is a great way to protect your skin from the sun. And they also learn about the amazing ways the sun helps the Earth.

programme.title: Tarzan and Jane
programme.desc: Baby Tarzan is rescued from a plane crash by the gorilla, Kala, and brought to a Shaman who treats Tarzan's injuries with a mix of native medicines and experimental science - saving Tarzan's life and giving him supernatural animal powers in the process. Tarzan is returned to Kala and remains in the jungle, defending animals from poachers, hunters and other threats. As a teenager, Tarzan is discovered by an expedition team from London, paid for by his billionaire grandfather. It is during this expedition where Tarzan meets Jane, and they become fast friends. Later, a series of mishaps takes him to London, reuniting Tarzan not only with his long lost family, but Jane as well. It is here where Tarzan and Jane learn to navigate the “urban jungle” of London, and uncover a dastardly plot to steal and sell exotic animals to the highest bidder! It is up to our heroes to figure out who is behind this sinister deed, and return the animals to their rightful homes in the jungle.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard, Al Grey, Alvin Batiste & Al Casey
programme.sub-title: Freddie Hubbard & The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone. Hubbard is an American jazz trumpeter whose unmistakable and influential tone contributed to new perspectives for modern jazz and bebop. He was also a well-known part of Art Blakey and the Jazz Messengers and is primarily known for playing bebop, hard bop, and post-bop styles from the early '60s onwards.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Coleman Hawkins
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Le Quatuor Ebène
programme.sub-title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination. In their live appearances, tours and concerts, plus a succession of recordings built on the cornerstone of four albums made between 1960 and 1963, Loussier's group achieved the breakthrough to popular commercial success enjoyed by only a select few jazz musicians. In fifteen years, the trio sold over six million albums! On July 28th 2004, the day of Bach's 254th anniversary of death, the Jacques Loussier Trio perform a special concert at the famous St. Thomas Church of Leipzig - the city where Bach composed many of his most famous works.

programme.title: Jaco Pastorius
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world. In this concert, he is accompanied by Peter Erskine (drums), Don Alias (percussion), Othello Molineaux (steel drums), Bob Mintzer (tenor sax and bass clarinet), and Randy Brecker (trumpet and electronics). They perform “Chicken”, “Donna Lee”, “Mr. Phone Bone”, and “Fannie Mae”. Don't miss this extraordinary opportunity to experience Jaco Pastorius's electrifying performance at the Montreal Jazz Festival 1982!

programme.title: Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove' is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: Tim Hagans, Greg Osby, Javon Jackson & Kevin Hays
programme.sub-title: Jazz Open Stuttgart: Blue Note All Stars
programme.desc: Playing together for the first time, this concert features the "young lions" of the late 1990s, the cream of contemporary jazz musicians. As a team of individualists, they mix contemporary and traditional jazz in a whole new way, playing well-known standards as well as their own compositions. With Tim Hagans on trumpet, Greg Osby on alto sax, Javon Jackson on tenor sax, Kevin Hays on piano, Esslet Esslet on double bass, and Bill Stewart on drums, this is an amazing line up. Over the years, they have each established themselves as forward-thinking and inventive band leaders, composers, and studio musicians, astonishing audiences around the world with their creativity and technical versatility.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen's trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv', conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen's signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine. Cohen, who also supplies vocalizations in the Judeo-Spanish dialect Ladino, came to prominence internationally in the 1990s when jazz great Chick Corea offered him a place in his trio and a recording deal. Thirty years later, Cohen has become a house-hold name himself, leaving his Ukrainian audience enthralled and connected through the universal language of music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Gregory Porter, Chip Crawford, Aaron James & Emanuel Harrold
programme.sub-title: Gregory Porter at the Blue Note Festival
programme.desc: Unlike many of his fellow jazz cats, vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble. After sustaining a shoulder injury, this former American football player turned to jazz singing. He was discovered in a Californian jazz club by pianist, saxophonist and composer Kamau Kenyatta. Porter lent his vocal skills to gospel choirs across the country and a string of successful musicals before turning his talent to his own compositions. His rise since then has been meteoric. Porter's magnificent, burnished baritone can sink into a lyric with luxurious ease, the melody gently sculpted into new shapes at every turn, with the rhythm tugging subtly back and forth across the bar line. This live performance at the Olympia showcases this man's worth, and is a truly amazing experience!

programme.title: Ballet of the Mariinsky Theatre
programme.desc: 'La Bayadère' is a three-act ballet by the French choreographer Marius Petipa. Set in 19th-century India, 'La Bayadère' tells the sad love story of the noble warrior Solor and his Nikia, a temple dancer or 'bayadère', who is poisoned by her rival, Gamzatti. The ballet features one of the most celebrated scenes of classical ballet, namely 'The Kingdom of the Shades'. In this iconic scene, Solor dreams, under the influence of opium, of reuniting with his beloved Nikia. This production of the ballet features the revised choreography by Vladimir Ponomarev and Vakhtang Chabukiani (1941), and includes dances by Konstantin Sergeyev and Nikolai Zubkovsky. The ballet's music, composed by Ludwig Minkus, is performed by the Mariinsky Orchestra under the direction of Boris Gruzin. Among the performers are Viktoria Tereshkina, Anastasia Matvienko, Vladimir Shklyarov, and Vladimir Ponomarev. This performance was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg, Russia, in July 2014.

programme.title: Christine Nonbo Andersen, Tuva Semmingsen, David Bateson & Steffen Bruun
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra takes us on a spectacular symphonic space journey in an out-of-this-world concert program of film music. Under the direction of Dutch conductor Antony Hermus, the orchestra guides us through the musical universe, performing a selection of music from iconic sci-fi movies, such as Avatar, Gravity, Interstellar, and Star Wars, written by major composers such as John Williams, Hans Zimmer, and James Horner. Featured soloists in this concert are Tuva Semmingsen, Christine Nonbo Andersen, Steffen Bruun, and David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in August 2021.

programme.title: Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería & José Areán
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 10 is an unfinished work left by the composer at his death, representing his ultimate emotional journey from torment and heartbreak to an unreserved acceptance of life and human love. The symphony, built on the composer's personal anguish and existential explorations, is characterized by its deep emotional range, intricate orchestration, and epic scale, culminating in a powerful affirmation of human connection in the face of mortality. Deryck Cook completed a version of the work with the help of materials provided by Mahler's widow.

programme.title: Soloists of the Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Ivan Fischer, Budapest Festival Orchestra & Richard Goode
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Iván Fischer leads his Budapest Festival Orchestra (BFO) in a concert program dedicated to the music of Ludwig van Beethoven. The program opens with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21. Afterward, Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist. The acclaimed American pianist (1943) is known for his interpretations of the Beethoven repertoire. Goode recorded all five Beethoven piano concertos with the BFO and Fischer, earning him exceptional critical acclaim and a Grammy Award nomination. As an encore, Goode performs the Sarabande from J. S. Bach's Partita in B-flat major, BWV 825. The program closes with Beethoven's famous Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. This performance was recorded at the Béla Bartók National Concert Hall in Budapest, Hungary, on January 29, 2017.

programme.title: Bob Marley & The Wailers
programme.desc: Bob Marley the world-renowned Jamaican guitarist, songwriter and reggae singer hailed as undeniably one of the greatest artists of all-time. Marley not only achieved mass critical acclaim across the decades but generated record sales in excess of 75 million, securing his place as a global icon. Capturing Bob Marley's last ever tour before his tragically early death, The Uprising Tour of 1980 spanned both Europe and the US in support of the album release of the same name, Uprising, which was to be his final studio album. This live show from Dortmund's Westfalenhalle was filmed for the famous German music TV series Rockpalast on June 13th 1980, featuring Bob Marley on superb form. Expertly delivering a set of hit singles and classic album tracks, Marley's energetic, charismatic performance includes I Shot The Sheriff, Get Up, Stand Up and No Woman, No Cry and the film has been substantially restored to a high level.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix
programme.desc: This expanded edition of "Jimi Plays Berkeley" showcases some of the guitarist's finest performances, captured May 30, 1970 at two concerts at the Berkeley Community Theatre. The film documents political unrest and student uprisings juxtaposed against live renditions of “Johnny B. Goode,” “I Don't Live Today” and more.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 2
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.title: FAITES ENTRER L'ACCUSÉ
programme.desc: Le 8 août 2003, Jean-François André, chef du club des motards MC Drôme, a été retrouvé mort à quelques mètres de chez lui, couché aux côtés de sa moto, dans un champ de maïs. Surnommé La Pie par ses proches, il avait fondé le premier club de bikers « Outlaws » en France. Les gendarmes chargés de l'enquête se heurtent vite au code d'honneur des bikers, des hommes peu bavards qui préfèrent en découdre eux-mêmes avec l'assassin de leur leader. Un appel anonyme leur fournit une unique piste : ce serait un ancien ami de La Pie, Michel Di Bacco, qui aurait commandité le meurtre à Gérald Crouzet, un ex-biker et collectionneur d'armes, appelé La Couette.

programme.title: FAITES ENTRER L'ACCUSÉ

La jeune fille a été violée et exécutée d'une balle dans la nuque. Pendant dix-neuf ans, la police est tenue en échec. Mais en 2006, l'ADN retrouvé sur la victime révèle enfin un nom ! Celui d'un homme fiché à la suite d'une banale bagarre...

programme.title: SEULS FACE A L'ALASKA

programme.title: CRIMES (9EME COMMANDE)
programme.desc: Meurtre sous perfusionLe 21 juillet 1999, Beatriz, une femme de 48 ans, est admise à la clinique d'Eich, au coeur de la ville de Luxembourg. Elle souffre d'une infection appelée "stafilocoque doré", une bactérie particulièrement féroce. Mais au bout de quelques jours, les antibiotiques semblent faire effet et la patiente est en voie de guérison. Quand soudain, le soir du 26 juillet, Beatriz fait un malaise. Appelés en urgence, les infirmiers et médecins tentent le tout pour le tout, mais ne parviennent pas à la sauver. Pour tous, c'est l'incompréhension : comment l'état de Beatriz a-t-il pu empirer si brutalement ? Au sein de la clinique, l'un des infirmiers pense avoir la réponse : la patiente aurait été empoisonnée ! L'affaire prend alors une tournure criminelle et l'enquête est confiée à la police judiciaire. Très vite, les soupçons se portent sur un homme : son mari, qui n'est autre que le directeur du laboratoire de la clinique ! Mais pourquoi aurait-il tué l'amour de sa vie ? Plongez dans cette passionnante affaire qui va révéler le passé trouble d'un homme respecté de tous et qui 15 ans après les faits, continue de clamer son innocence.Macabre mise en scèneLe 1er novembre 2010, au cimetière d'Hassel, tout près de Luxembourg ville, deux hommes s'inquiètent. En ce jour de Toussaint, leur frère Camille n'est pas venu à la traditionnelle cérémonie, ce qui n'est pas dans ses habitudes. Pour en avoir le coeur net, ils décident de se rendre chez lui. Mais en pénétrant dans sa chambre, c'est un spectacle d'horreur qui les attend : leur frère est étendu dans son lit, dans une mare de sang, la gorge tranchée ! Les policiers arrivent immédiatement sur les lieux et font les premières constatations. Camille ne présente aucune trace de défense et a visiblement été tué dans son sommeil. Dans la salle de bain, les enquêteurs découvrent une hache nettoyée et encore humide. Et ils ne sont pas au bout de leurs surprises : dans le bureau, ils découvrent une bible ouverte dans laquelle est plantée un couteau ! Et sur l'une des pages le mot "Pédofile" est inscrit à la main ! Alors, que signifie cette macabre mise en scène ? Qui pouvait en vouloir à ce paisible retraité ? Découvrez cette passionnante enquête qui va mettre à jour les secrets d'un homme un peu trop généreux qui l'a peut-être payé de sa vie.Mystérieuse disparition de NancyLe 2 mai 2010, une mère et son gendre poussent la porte du commissariat de Diekirch, au nord est du pays. Ils viennent signaler la disparition de Nancy, 25 ans. La dernière fois que son compagnon l'a vue, c'était il y a 3 jours : après un dîner au restaurant, elle était montée dans la voiture de deux hommes sans aucune explication... Pour les enquêteurs, Nancy semble être partie de son plein gré, mais sa mère en est persuadée : jamais elle n'aurait abandonné sa petite fille de 15 mois ! Mais après deux semaines de recherches, les policiers sont dans l'impasse. Jusqu'à ce que le témoignage d'une voisine vienne faire basculer l'enquête ! Alors qui pouvait en vouloir à cette jeune mère de famille ? Plongez dans ce terrible fait divers qui a tenu en haleine les policiers luxembourgeois pendant près de 7 mois et dont l'issue tragique a choqué tout le pays.

programme.title: Tach Berlin! Sightseeing-Tour der Superlative!

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas: Liebe, Luxus und eine zweite Hochzeit?
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss kommen aus dem Staunen nicht mehr heraus. Ihre "Bleibe"? Ein wahrer Palast! Da fehlen sogar Carmen die Worte. Im Caesars Palace residieren sie als VIPs in einer luxuriösen Villa mit Privataufzug und Butler. (S3 E12)

programme.title: Alles auf die 20?! Robert Geiss spielt Roulette...
programme.desc: Pure Eskalation in Las Vegas! Die Geissens zocken im Casino mit 20k! Doch die Kugel rollt anders als gewollt. Aber dann geschieht ein Wunder! Robert Geiss kassiert einen richtig fetten Gewinn! (S3 E15)

programme.title: Pure Action! Familientrip in die Universal Studios!
programme.desc: Die Geissens sind zu Besuch in den Universal Studios. Hinter die Kulissen von Hollywood schauen? Kein Problem! Explosionen, Erdbeben und Fluten: Hier wird nicht an Special Effects gespart! (S3 E17)

programme.title: Oldtimer-Spritztour: Robert Geiss findet die Bremse
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert Geiss suchen in den USA nach Inspiration für eigene Bauprojekte. Carmen ist begeistert von den Ideen. Robert zeigt eher wenig Begeisterung... Jetzt hilft nur noch eins: eine Spritztour! Aber wo sind eigentlich die Bremsen? (S3 E18)

programme.title: PS-Spektakel: 🏎️ Robert Geiss auf der
programme.desc: Für Robert heißt es: Rasen, was das Zeug hält. Denn in Ischgl hat er ein klares Ziel vor Augen. Er will seine beste Rundenzeit auf der Kartbahn knacken! Doch das ist eine echte Herausforderung... Für Robert wird's so richtig anstrengend. (S3 E18)

programme.title: Mega-Fail in Monaco: Bierdusche für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Formel-1-Wochenende in Monaco, und natürlich wird nichts dem Zufall überlassen! Von der Luxus-Terrasse bis zum Sternekoch - hier wurde an alles gedacht! Doch plötzlich passiert's: Carmen Geiss kriegt unfreiwillig eine "Bierdusche" ab! (S3 E18)

programme.title: Letzter Stopp: San Francisco! Nachts allein in
programme.desc: In San Francisco angekommen, erkunden Robert und Carmen Geiss die Golden Gate Bridge! Als Abschluss ihrer USA-Reise gibt es noch eine private Führung im berühmtesten Gefängnis der Welt: Alcatraz! Allerdings kriegt Carmen richtig Muffensausen.. (S3 E19)

programme.title: Ohne Fleiß
programme.sub-title: kein Preis: Carmen Geiss' Kampf gegen
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss hat ihr Ziel vor Augen: Fünf Kilo abnehmen. Nach anderthalb Stunden Workout ist die ehemalige Miss Fitness auch fix und fertig - aber glücklich! (S3 E20)

programme.title: Ein Rennen gegen die Zeit: Speed-Shopping in Cannes!
programme.desc: Kaum in Cannes angekommen, beginnt Carmen Geiss mit ihrer Jagd nach Schuhen! Immerhin gibt es im Ausverkauf satte 50 Prozent Rabatt! Da muss sie einfach zuschlagen! (S4 E01)

programme.title: Ciao Milano! Familie Geiss auf Erkundungstour...
programme.desc: Die Geissens erkunden Mailand, vom Dom bis zur Leonardo-Statue. Carmen führt die Familie, während die kranke Davina mit den Großeltern ins Hotel zurückkehrt. Shania genießt die Zeit mit den Eltern, inklusive Juwelierbesuch. (S4 E02)

programme.title: Ganz nach Carmens Geschmack: Sixpack-Alarm in Miami!
programme.desc: Hot, hotter, South Beach! Hier jagt ein heißer Sixpack den nächsten! Carmen Geiss kommt aus dem Staunen gar nicht mehr heraus! Die "Beach Boys" haben es ihr so richtig angetan. (S4 E04)

programme.title: "Rakete auf dem Wasser!" Action-Urlaub in Miami...
programme.desc: Jetzt geht es mit Vollspeed über Miamis Küstengewässer. Doch nicht jedem gefallen 150 km/h so gut wie Robert Geiss… Denn Ehefrau Carmen bekommt Panik. (S4 E05)

programme.title: Carmen Geiss sieht Rot! Schluss mit Camping?!
programme.desc: Robert Geiss will Action, also sollen Carmen und Töchterchen Shania mit ihm Hovercraft fahren. Leider ist das Fahrzeug ROT. Da bekommt Frau Geiss direkt Schnappatmung, denn eine Wahrsagerin hat ihr das Ende in einem ROTEN Fahrzeug prophezeit... (S4 E07)

programme.title: Splish, Splash! Wasserspaß auf Privatinsel!

programme.title: Jetzt wird's wild: Crocodile-Carmen und
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss erkunden die gefährlichen Everglades und wollen sich den Alligatoren und Schlangen stellen! So zumindest der Plan. Anfangs ist weit und breit nichts zu sehen, doch plötzlich sind sie von allen Seiten umzingelt! (S4 E11)

programme.title: "Weihnachtsglocken" im Moulin Rouge!
programme.desc: Während Carmen sich in Paris von den historischen Gebäuden und den Lichtern der Stadt beeindrucken lässt, träumt Robert von den leicht bekleideten Damen des „Moulin Rouge“. (S4 E12)

programme.title: Überraschung! Geheimer Kurztrip für Carmen Geiss'
programme.desc: Robert Geiss hat etwas Großes für den Geburtstag seiner Ehefrau Carmen geplant. Also heißt es: Carmen die Augen verbinden und ins Auto laden. Für seine Liebste ist ihm nämlich nichts zu teuer: Er hat sogar eine Presidential Suite gebucht! (S4 E14)

programme.title: Ciao Venezia! Carmen Geiss' Traum wird endlich wahr...
programme.desc: Carmen Geiss' Geburtstagswochenende nimmt nochmal richtig Fahrt auf! Nächste Aktivität: venezianische Masken bemalen. Während Carmen Geiss ganz filigran den Pinsel schwingt, ist Ehemann Robert Geiss nach einem kompletten Anstrich schon fertig – typisch! (S4 E15)

programme.title: Typisch Geissens! Action statt Entspannung in
programme.desc: Familie Geiss macht einen Wochenendtrip nach Saint-Tropez! Carmen Geiss freut sich auf ein entspanntes Wochenende, aber daraus wird wohl nichts. Ehemann Robert Geiss hat andere Pläne: Ein Boot ist organisiert, und es geht direkt aufs Wasser! (S5 E01)

programme.title: Robert Geiss' neue Karriere: Kart-Profi in Ischgl?!
programme.desc: Vollgas in Ischgl! Robert Geiss hat große Pläne: Beim Summer Opening im Kartfahren will er mit den Profis mithalten. Doch kaum angekommen, wird ihm klar – hier fahren echte Könner! (S5 E02)

programme.title: Party-Alarm: Davina Geiss' XXL-Geburtstag!
programme.desc: Ein richtig großer Tag für Davina Geiss! Heute wird das Geburtstagskind stolze neun Jahre alt! Für Carmen und Robert Geiss heißt das: Zeit für eine absolute Mega-Party! Eine Überraschung jagt die nächste! (S5 E04)

programme.title: Spektakulär: Bulgarien-Reise à la Robert Geiss!
programme.desc: Mit dem Helikopter fliegt die Familie ans Schwarze Meer. Bei diesem Ausblick verschlägt es sogar Carmen Geiss die Sprache! Doch nach all der Ruhe am Strand wird plötzlich der "Ballermann" von Bulgarien anvisiert. (S5 E05)

programme.title: Schock: "Wie kann man denn sowas machen?"
programme.desc: Heute steht für die Geissens eine Bootstour auf dem Programm! Robert Geiss will seinen Kindern endlich zeigen, wie man einen Fisch angelt. Doch plötzlich hört er ein lautes Platschen und Schreie! Opa Reinhold Geiss ist ins Wasser gefallen! (S5 E07)

programme.title: Schock in Bodrum! Robert Geiss verletzt?!
programme.desc: In Bodrum gönnen sich Robert und Carmen Geiss eine wohlverdiente Auszeit. Ein riesiges Luxus-Boot darf dabei natürlich nicht fehlen. Doch die Erholung währt nicht lange – Robert hat sich verletzt! (S5 E08)

programme.title: Totalausfall: Luxus-Villa-Flop auf Ibiza?!
programme.desc: Die Geissens gönnen sich eine Auszeit auf Ibiza. Ein riesiges Luxus-Anwesen gehört dabei natürlich zum Standardprogramm… Doch es gibt ein Problem: Die Klimaanlage des Hauses funktioniert nicht! (S5 E09)

programme.title: Wer wird Ibizas next Po-Model?!
programme.desc: Es geht in die nächste Runde! Carmen und Robert Geiss unterstützen ihren Freund Walter bei einem Model-Casting. Die Models geben Vollgas und dabei wird es feuchtfröhlich! (S5 E10)

programme.title: Action auf hoher See: Robert Geiss verbannt das
programme.desc: Robert und Carmen Geiss nehmen auf Monacos Bootmesse alles genau unter die Lupe. Auf dem Wasser soll dann die Post abgehen! Doch dabei stört die Kamera! Also wird diese, samt Kamerateam, einfach vom Boot verwiesen. (S5 E11)

programme.title: Völlig crazy: Opa Geiss in High Heels?!
programme.desc: Carmen und Robert besuchen die Starnacht am Wörthersee, feiern mit Feuerwerk und einem Auftritt von Gregor Glanz. Am nächsten Tag treffen sie Fans für Autogramme und Fotos. Dann wird es peinlich, als Opa Reinhold Carmens High Heels an sich nimmt. (S5 E12)

programme.title: Nervenzusammenbruch? Ein Horrortrip für Carmen Geiss!
programme.desc: Es wird richtig wild! Die Geissens besuchen Seaworld in Orlando und Carmen Geiss muss mit Tochter Davina auf die Achterbahn. Diese entpuppt sich für Carmen als echter Horrortrip... (S5 E13)

programme.title: Mom Must Go Back to Daughter's High School

programme.desc: Chad, a lazy law student, uses a "genius serum" to ace exams and impress a girl. When the serum's effects fade, he faces academic and financial ruin, forcing him to abandon shortcuts and embrace hard work, ultimately finding true success.

programme.title: Students Face The World's Toughest Exam
programme.desc: In a dystopian future where failed exams mean execution, Carson, the Governor's son, discovers the system is rigged. With his genius friend Maya and a tenacious journalist, he exposes the corruption, fighting to save his loved ones and ignite a revolution.

programme.title: Foster Girl Is Overnight Billionaire
programme.desc: After law student Cindy inherits a fortune, her boyfriend Dave secretly plots to steal it. With help from unlikely allies, she exposes his infidelity and greed, then starts a charity to help others.

programme.title: Influencer Mom Forgets Her Child While Shopping
programme.desc: Rivalling influencers Blair and Serena fight over a prize, causing Blair to leave her kids in a car. Her husband fakes a theft to teach her a lesson. The women reconcile and prioritize family over fame.

programme.title: Poor Girl Is Shamed for Cheap Gifts
programme.desc: Amy hides her poverty from her wealthy best friend, Carmen, to fit in. Rival Brandy exposes Amy's fake designer bag, but is then arrested for fraud. Amy reconciles with Carmen and finds true value.

programme.title: Girl Fakes As Guy To Play Hockey Championship
programme.desc: To help her brother Ben pursue his e-sports dream, athletic Kristy poses as him to lead their struggling hockey team to a championship. Her talent earns her a college scholarship and forces her traditionalist father to finally respect his children's true passions.

programme.title: Mom Doesn't Know Son Is Art Legend
programme.desc: In the Bronx, artistic teen Devon uses his talent to escape a cycle of poverty and abuse. After finding a mentor in his teacher and overcoming personal tragedy, he achieves global fame on TikTok.

programme.title: Tomboy Is Shamed at Her School
programme.desc: Jessie, a tomboyish Punjabi teen, struggles with conservative parental expectations. Inspired by Lilly Singh, she raps an original song at her school talent show to come out and embrace her true self.

programme.title: Teenager Is Bullied for Going Bald
programme.desc: After a jealous rival exposes his secret balding, high school king Louie loses his popularity and girlfriend. Encouraged by a resilient coworker, he shaves his head, reclaims his confidence, and finds true self-worth as homecoming king.

programme.title: Older Bro Kicks Out Little Bro
programme.desc: After a car accident paralyzes his first date, Chris defies his traditional brother's pressure to abandon her. Choosing love over cultural expectations, he stays by her side to build a life together.

programme.title: Deaf Girl Finds Out Why She Can't Hear
programme.desc: Lana, deaf since age 10, is bullied and isolated, saving for surgery. When her family faces eviction, she sacrifices her fund. Eli, burdened by past cowardice, bullies her. A new friend, Hailey, helps Lana find acceptance, leading to a fateful encounter where Eli redeems himself.

programme.title: Foster Mom Won't Let Kid See Birth Mom
programme.desc: Kind bus driver Charlie loses his job after driving a foster child across town to see his dying mother. His viral act of compassion results in a massive fundraiser, allowing him to adopt the boy.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die Gastgeber Britta und Stefan freuen sich über einen bisher gelungenen Silvesterabend mit Freunden. Als es ums Teilen der Kosten für die fröhliche Pärchenparty geht, schlägt die Stimmung jäh um: sooo viele Garnelen haben die einen gar nicht gegessen …

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Tina lässt sich im Computerladen von Verkäufer Frank beraten. Er empfiehlt die „saugeile“ Grafikkarte. Oder – wenn sie auf Nummer sicher gehen will – eine „hammergeile“. Die wäre dann sowohl für „dies und das“ als auch für „alles Mögliche“ geeignet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Arbeitsalltag im Großraumbüro: Birte will um ein Uhr in die Mittagspause und fragt in die Runde, ob die Kollegen mitkommen, sich die Titten vergrößern lassen. Die Kollegen sind ehrlich bestürzt, denn einige von Ihnen waren bereits in der Mittagspause …

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Judith und die lebensgroße Ratte Rolf sitzen beim gemeinsamen Essen im Restaurant. Der Kellner bietet als Dessert eine Käseplatte an, was Rolf als Diskriminierungsversuch deutet: „Käse? Weil ich ne Ratte bin, oder was?

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die Badenixen Nina und Ute sonnen sich, als sie den Strandverkäufer Tom entdecken und heranwinken. Tom ist über und über mit Uhren, Hüten und weiteren Utensilien behängt. Im Gespräch stellt sich heraus, dass er gar nichts verkaufen möchte.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Die besten Sketche aus der vierten Staffel Ladykracher. Natürlich gibt es auch ein Wiedersehen mit der legendären Pimmelnase, dem vergesslichen Tätowierten und der Deutschstunde für Anfänger. Anke Engelke und das große Ladykracher-Special!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bionade Litschi und Lauchrhabarber-Quiche – so etwas unmännliches gibt es nicht, wenn Anke Engelke die Biergartenbedienung ist. Doch auch als Tennistrainerin kennt sie keine Gnade. Ladykracher ist endlich zurück und wie gewohnt zündet Anke mit ihrem einzigartigen Ensemble wieder ein Feuerwerk an durchgeknallten Sketche ab.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Männer sind wie Tiere – erst recht, wenn es darum geht gegenüber dem Konkurrenten sein Revier zu markieren. Doch auch Frauen können ganz anders – das beweist Anke mal wieder in zahlreichen durchgeknallten Sketchen!

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Auf geht's in eine neue Runde voller abgefahrener Sketche bei Ladykracher. In dieser brandneuen Episode brilliert Anke wieder einmal in zig verschiedenen Rollen von der betrügenden Ehegattin ohne schlechtes Gewissen bis zur selbstbewussten Onka.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Wii-Boxen ist der neueste Trend – genau das Richtige für Anke. Schlagkräftig geht es auch in den anderen Sketchen zu : egal, ob Superman Tennis spielt oder der Horrorklassiker „Saw“ parodiert wird – „Ladykracher“ ist einfach unschlagbar witzig.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Als ob der Job im Freizeitpark nicht schon anstrengend genug wäre: ohne das Maskottchen-Kostüm wird es allerdings nicht leichter. Außerdem zeigt Anke, was es bedeutet Opfer des Trickfickers zu werden oder wie Onka eine Yogastunde leitet.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Bonuspunkte an der Kasse kann doch keiner mehr sehen – Koi-Karpfen sind dagegen der letzte Schrei! Das kann man von einer Darmspiegelung nicht gerade sagen, aber der gemeine Arschkriecher muss ja irgendwie wieder raus.

programme.title: Ladykracher
programme.desc: Kinderschminken kann aber auch einfach unheimlich echt wirken – Vorsicht ist angesagt! Sensible Küchengeräte wiederum sollte man nicht mit Horrorfilmen verschrecken. Diese und weitere Weisheiten gibt's bei Ladykracher.

programme.title: New York
programme.desc: Tommy und Scarlet wollen in New York groß rauskommen. Scarlet macht sich Sorgen, weil ihr neuer Agent so jung ist, und Tommy hinterlässt bei den neuen Mitbewohnern einen schlechten ersten Eindruck.

programme.title: Zwei zum Preis von einer
programme.desc: Scarlet hat ein schlechtes Gewissen, weil sie Tommy bei einem Casting hintergangen hat. Molly willigt aus Mitleid mit einem nerdigen Fan ein, mit ihm zum Abschlussball zu gehen, doch Jess drängt sich dazwischen.

programme.title: PowerPoint des Todes
programme.desc: Matt erstellt eine beeindruckende Präsentation, um der CIA in gutem Glauben Hampton DeVilles Waffenhandel anzupreisen. Währenddessen macht sich Jake die firmeninterne Whistleblower-App zunutze.

programme.title: Der Schmerz des Lebens
programme.desc: Nach Jakes Operation schmeicheln sich seine Kollegen bei ihm ein, in der Hoffnung, dass er seine verschreibungspflichtigen Schmerzmittel mit ihnen teilt. Den an Schlafmangel leidenden Matt verfolgen Visionen von einem Geist.

programme.title: Trademarq
programme.desc: Hampton DeVille schließt sich mit einem Straßenkünstler zusammen, der die Firmenzentrale beschädigt hat, um Anti-Konzern-Merchandise zu verkaufen und von den Gegnern zu profitieren.

programme.title: Firmen-Klausur
programme.desc: Auf der Firmen-Klausur von Hampton DeVille bringen Business-Gurus Matt bei, wie man selbstsicherer wird. Jake findet Liebe bei einer Networking-Party.

programme.title: Casual Friday
programme.desc: Matt und Jake haben Mühe, einen Kollegen zu überzeugen, am Casual Friday ein Hemd zu tragen, und Christian bemüht sich, mit einer Gruppe von Megakirchen einen Handel abzuschließen.

programme.title: Das lange Meeting
programme.desc: John und Kate müssen die Leitung eines Meetings übernehmen, als Christian einen Anruf erhält. Sie schließen das Personal ohne ihre Handys im Konferenzraum ein, bis sie mit dem Brainstorming fertig sind.

programme.title: Die Gesellschaft von morgen
programme.desc: Während die Mitarbeiter besessen von einer hochkarätigen TV-Serie sind, widersteht Jake ihren Versuchen, ihn dazu zu bringen, sie ebenfalls anzusehen. In Matts Leben passiert indessen auf unheimliche Weise das Gleiche wie in der Serie.

programme.title: Wochenende
programme.desc: John drängt Jake und Matt, ihm zu helfen, eine Standuhr in sein Apartment zu bringen, und sabotiert damit ihre Wochenendpläne.

programme.title: Tag der Erinnerung
programme.desc: Matt bewältigt sein Familientrauma, indem er sich in die Büro-Weihnachtsfeier stürzt, Christian hinterfragt sein Weltbild, und Jake zieht in Erwägung, die Firma zu verlassen.

programme.title: Takeshis Castle Thailand

Lakshmi ist eine starke und mitfühlende Frau, die zur emotionalen Stütze einer Familie wird, die von Liebe getragen, aber von Konflikten, Erwartungen und dem Wandel der Zeit herausgefordert wird. Während Generationen aufeinandertreffen und verborgene Wahrheiten ans Licht kommen, muss Lakshmi zwischen Pflicht, Opferbereitschaft und persönlichem Glück ihren eigenen Weg finden. Die Serie erzählt von Vertrauen, Zusammenhalt und der Bedeutung von Familie – Themen, die universell verständlich sind. programme.title: Opn Dörp
programme.desc: Bülkau ist klein, unscheinbar und außergewöhnlich. Denn Bülkau ist das längste Dorf im Norden. Mitten im Elbe-Weser-Dreieck erstreckt sich der Ort über 14 Kilometer an der Landesstraße 144. Viel Platz gibt es hier für die knapp 900 Einwohner. Wiesen und Weiden, wohin man blickt, frische Luft von der Nordsee und Himmel ohne Ende. Traditionen werden gepflegt, das Dorfleben ist ausgeprägt, gefeiert wird gern und viel, zum Beispiel beim Schützenfest mit 'Grün holen? und 'Bunt machen?.
