programme.desc: Écran Large : actu ciné, séries, comics, jeux vidéo

programme.title: Le Chemin du passé
programme.desc: Des années après la disparition d'un scientifique, sa famille trouve un indice pouvant le ramener chez lui.

programme.title: Serieously Ep.31
programme.desc: Ton rendez-vous francophone préféré sur les séries, le cinéma et la pop culture en général!

programme.title: Gagarin : first in space
programme.desc: Le 12 avril 1961, le cosmonaute soviétique Youri Gagarine devient le premier homme à voyager dans l'espace.

programme.title: The Best Offer
programme.desc: Virgil Oldman, un expert en art reclus, acquiert des tableaux inestimables en trompant leurs propriétaires sur leur valeur. Engagé par la mystérieuse Claire Ibbetson pour évaluer son patrimoine, Virgil découvre des pièces mécaniques et demande l'aide de son ami Robert pour les réassembler.

programme.title: Monte Carlo
programme.desc: Selena Gomez joue le rôle d'une fille ordinaire dont le voyage d'été à Paris se transforme en rêve de sa vie lorsqu'elle devient une princesse accidentelle en assumant l'identité d'une autre personne.

programme.title: L'amour à nouveau
programme.desc: Ricky et Tara sont un couple récemment divorcé qui doit relever les défis de la coparentalité avec leur jeune fils tout en se remettant des blessures causées par l'échec de leur relation.

programme.title: Love's Kitchen
programme.desc: Rob Haley, chef talentueux de Londres, est en deuil quand il perd sa femme. Avec les encouragements de son célèbre ami et Chef, Gordon Ramsay, Rob se lance un nouveau défi : transformer un vieux pub à la dérive en restaurant gastronomique.

programme.title: Amour et préjugés
programme.desc: Une jeune policière rêvant de trouver l'amour et un propriétaire de bar entre dans un jeu romantique du chat et de la souris alors qu'ils voulaient orienter leurs vies amoureuses dans d'autres directions.

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: The story of a long-lost book that mysteriously reappears and connects an old man searching for his son with a girl seeking a cure for her mother's loneliness.

programme.title: 2H22
programme.desc: Au cours d'une nuit enneigée, une équipe de quatre cambrioleurs expérimentés planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l'amitié, la loyauté et la confiance qui les lient seront poussées à leur limite.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l'université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d'un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome Gilles de la Tourette, fait la rencontre de Marie et Alex dans une clinique spécialisée. Ce trio atypique s'embarque dans le voyage de sa vie.

programme.title: Les Super-Héros: Comment Ont-ils Conquis le Monde?
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire de la transition des super-héros de bandes dessinées au cinéma, des films de Tim Burton sur Batman jusqu'aux Avengers, Black Panther et au-delà, montrant comment ils ont d'abord conquis Hollywood puis le monde entier.

programme.title: Standard
programme.desc: À Sclessin, les fans du Standard de Liège vivent pour le club : chants, animations… Une passion folle, faite d'amour et de collectif, qui les pousse à tout donner pour leurs couleurs, jour après jour.

programme.title: Le Terrain
programme.desc: Une immersion bouleversante au milieu des jeunes joueurs du club de foot d'Aubervilliers, et de leurs rêves de gloire.

programme.title: The Road Within
programme.desc: Vincent, atteint du syndrome Gilles de la Tourette, fait la rencontre de Marie et Alex dans une clinique spécialisée. Ce trio atypique s'embarque dans le voyage de sa vie.

programme.title: Deuce Bigalow: European Gigolo
programme.desc: Redevenu nettoyeur professionnel d'aquariums, Deuce Bigalow croyait son éphémère carrière de gigolo définitivement enterrée. Mais lorsque T.J. Hicks, son ancien entremetteur et ami, se retrouve impliqué en Europe dans les meurtres des plus séduisants gigolos, Deuce doit reprendre du service... Décidé à prouver l'innocence de T.J., Deuce réendosse son rôle de séducteur, mais il est toujours aussi peu doué et l'enquête vire au cauchemar. Pour percer le secret de la très puissante Société Européenne des Beaux-mecs-à-louer, Deuce va devoir se faire passer pour l'un d'eux et devenir le chevalier servant d'un tas de clientes toutes plus déjantées les unes que les autres. Parmi elles, la très belle Eva et son trouble obsessionnel compulsif du comportement...

programme.title: Paul Blart : Super Vigile
programme.desc: Doux et réfléchi, un agent de sécurité passe à l'action lorsque le supermarché dans lequel il travaille est la proie d'une bande de cambrioleurs très bien organisée. Il sera accompagné d'une vendeuse d'extensions de cheveux

programme.title: Rien Que Pour Vos Cheveux
programme.desc: Agent d'élite du Mossad et véritable star dans son pays, Zohan (Adam Sandler) rêve de devenir coiffeur en Amérique. Profitant d'un combat contre son pire ennemi, connu sous le nom de Fantôme, Zohan se fait passer pour mort et s'envole pour New York armé uniquement de ses ciseaux et de son sèche-cheveux. Malgré son inexpérience, il est engagé par la patronne d'un salon de coiffure, une jolie Palestinienne. Alors que son passé d'agent semble loin derrière lui, Zohan est repéré par le Fantôme, qui compte bien en finir avec lui une bonne fois pour toutes...

programme.title: Very Bad Cops
programme.desc: À New York, l'inspecteur Allen Gamble, un juricomptable plus intéressé par la paperasse que par l'action, et l'inspecteur Terry Hoitz, un dur à cuire, sont forcés de coopérer suite à un incident embarrassant. Allen et Terry, qui idolâtrent les deux meilleurs flics de la ville, Danson et Highsmith, vont avoir l'opportunité de prendre la relève, mais rien ne se passera exactement comme prévu.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Le jour où Luna, la fille du roi, disparaît, Georges, un valeureux chevalier, accompagné de son fidèle guerrier Garth, partent à la recherche de la princesse. En affrontant de multiples dangers, leur route va croiser celle dun gigantesque dragon et de dangereux mercenaires.

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: Brendan occupe tout seul un petit poste de péage sur une route secondaire du Pays de Galles. Il est au calme dans cet endroit, ce qui lui permet de dissimuler son passé criminel. Un jour, il est dévalisé par des malfaiteurs maladroits.

programme.title: Braqueurs Amateurs
programme.desc: Dick Harper vient de recevoir une grande promotion : il est nommé vice-président de la communication du groupe Globodyne. Forte de cette bonne nouvelle, son épouse, Jane, démissionne pour ne plus s'occuper que de leur fils et de leur belle maison.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez est l'acteur principal de cette comédie furieusement drôle au casting de rêve ! Lorsque Maximo, le séducteur latin vieillissant, se fait plaquer par la femme d'âge mûr qu'il a épousée pour son argent, il emménage chez sa sœur Sara, à qui il ne parlait plus son fils de dix ans.

programme.title: La course au soleil
programme.desc: Lorsque Charlotte Sutter est enlevée par des Apaches, son frère Sam, aidé par un vieux prospecteur ivre, part à sa recherche.

programme.title: L'ouragan de la vengeance
programme.desc: Trois cow-boys, pris pour des membres d'une bande de hors-la-loi, sont poursuivis sans relâche par un posse.

programme.title: Femmes hors-la-loi
programme.desc: Une Femme hors-la-loi oblige un jeune médecin à se rendre dans une ville dirigée par des femmes, dont l'indépendance est menacée par un gang criminel.

programme.title: Calibre 32
programme.desc: Super cool Silver tue les sept membres d'un gang masqué, un par un.

programme.title: 4 balles pour Joë
programme.desc: La mort mystérieuse d'un homme qui s'apprête à quitter une petite ville du Kansas avec sa petite amie déclenche une série d'événements malheureux.

programme.title: Le Rocher du Diable
programme.desc: Deux vieux amis se retrouvent dans des camps opposés pendant la guerre civile lors d'une bataille désespérée au sommet d'une montagne imprenable.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Quand il était petit, Johnny a vu son père tué par des soldats. Des années plus tard, il est devenu un hors-la-loi et tue des soldats chaque fois qu'il le peut. Le lieutenant Garringo (Steffen) est envoyé pour arrêter Johnny (Lawrence) et le ramener vivant.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Ben et Adam sont enfermés en prison, sur le point d'être pendus pour un crime qu'ils n'ont pas commis. Joe et Hoss doivent découvrir pourquoi les témoins du crime présumé se sont parjurés avant que l'exécution n'ait lieu.

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Aux Portes De L'Enfer
programme.desc: Le révérend Jonah Johnson et sa femme Isabelle sont des télé-évangélistes arnaqueurs. Repérés par la police, ils doivent partir pour Los Angeles. Afin d'habiter un vieux manoir abandonné, ils acceptent un marché avec une vieille femme très riche, Lady Calagari. Le couple devra ériger un culte à la gloire de Satan. Dès lors, des événements surnaturels font leur apparition et des meurtres inexpliqués s'enchaînent.

programme.title: Terreur sur l'asphalte
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres mystérieux a eu lieu à Montevideo, une petite ville en Californie. La femme d'un policier s'enfuit de son mari, cherchant à divorcer. Le policier tente de se réconcilier et commence à la suivre...

programme.title: FEAST 2: NO LIMIT
programme.desc: Les monstres se sont introduits dans une petite ville voisine au milieu de nulle part et les habitants doivent s'associer aux survivants du massacre du bar pour trouver un moyen de survivre.

programme.title: Alien Invasion : L'Éveil du Phénix
programme.desc: Une pluie d'astéroïdes frappe une station spatiale, puis atterrit dans une zone reculée du Grand Canyon. Des capsules mystérieuses se forment et mutent rapidement en créatures menaçant la station spatiale et la Terre.

programme.title: Ape vs Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Reconnaissant le pouvoir destructeur de son singe géant captif, l'armée fabrique sa propre I.A. prête au combat: Mecha Ape.

programme.title: Enlèvement
programme.desc: À la recherche d'une femme disparue dans le Dakota du Nord, un agent du FBI et un shérif se concentrent sur son mari, un fanatique religieux, mais découvrent quelque chose de bien plus sinistre.

programme.title: Time Run
programme.desc: Sergey, champion d'athlétisme brisé par un accident, découvre que ses blessures lui permettent de voir le passé quand son cœur s'emballe. Pendant ce temps, l'inspectrice Nastya traque un tueur de femmes dans la ville.

programme.title: Premier contact (2018)
programme.desc: Après avoir tout perdu dans un accident de voiture, la vie d'un artiste est à nouveau bouleversée lorsque ses amis découvrent qu'un objet d'un autre monde s'est écrasé dans un champ. Mais cette étrange forme de vie extraterrestre a-t-elle des intentions néfastes ?

programme.title: The Girl in the Book
programme.desc: Dans le milieu de l'édition new-yorkaise, une jeune éditrice est contrainte de faire face à un chapitre troublant de son passé lorsqu'un auteur à succès réapparaît dans sa vie.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Lovers évoque les amours contrariées d'une jeune française, Jeanne, et d'un peintre yougoslave, Dragan, qui réside sans visa en France. L'amour est ici peint comme une ultime résistance au chaos du monde.

programme.title: L'Oracle
programme.desc: Dans la Perse du XIe siècle, un apprenti chirurgien se déguise en Juif pour étudier dans une école qui n'admet pas de chrétiens.

programme.title: Manipulation
programme.desc: Alors que Doug a une liaison avec Lena, la mort suspecte du mari de cette dernière révèle l'existence d'une assurance vie conséquente..

programme.title: Almost Perfect
programme.desc: Lorsque la célèbre vlogueuse mère-fille Stella Marshall se retrouve en froid avec sa propre fille, elle attire l'attention de la dangereuse fangirl Peyton, qui ne reculera devant rien pour faire de Stella sa propre mère parfaite.

programme.title: Evil Boy
programme.desc: Igor est prêt à tout pour le bonheur de Polina et, pour compenser la perte de son fils, le couple décide d'adopter. Mais au lieu d'un garçon ordinaire du refuge, leur famille accueille un enfant plus que difficile.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Deux frères retournent dans la secte qu'ils ont fui des années auparavant pour découvrir que les croyances du groupe sont peut-être plus saines qu'ils ne le pensaient autrefois.

programme.title: The river king
programme.desc: Un jeune inspecteur de police d'une petite ville doit enquêter sur la noyade d'un étudiant. Le directeur de l'école étouffe le scandale en présentant ceci comme un suicide.

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: Spit'n'Split
programme.desc: Une tournée de rock band, c'est des fans prêtes à tomber le tanga pour un autographe, des brouettes de coke et des pluies de billets. Les membres de ce groupe de rock aimeraient confirmer ce mythe. Sauf qu'eux, ce sont des longs trajets dans un van pourri, de l'aspirine et des bars vides.

programme.title: Malum
programme.desc: Une jeune policière tente de percer le lien mystérieux entre la mort de son père et l'arrestation d'une secte. Pour ce faire, elle accepte de prendre poste dans le commissariat où son père a trouvé la mort. Bientôt, elle est victime d'événements surnaturels terrifiants...

programme.title: L'Enfer des Zombies
programme.desc: Un navire venu des Antilles accoste au port de New York sans âme qui vive à bord, si ce n'est un zombie qui attaque deux gardes côtes. Avec l'aide d'un journaliste, la fille du propriétaire du bateau décide d'aller enquêter aux Antilles pour retrouver son père. Ils se rendent sur l'île de Matu et y rencontrent le docteur David Menard, qui tente d'inventer un remède contre une maladie qui ramène les morts à la vie, les changeant en zombies cannibales.

programme.title: Mad Heidi
programme.desc: Dans une Suisse dystopique tombée sous la coupe fasciste d'un magnat du fromage, Heidi a une vie simple dans les Alpes. Son grand-père fait de son mieux pour protéger sa petite-fille de la dictature, mais bientôt son désir de liberté fait éclater l'enfer.

programme.title: Sharknado 4
programme.desc: Durant 5 ans, Fin et sa famille ont été à l'abri des requins mais ceux-ci sont de retour. Ils débarquent à Las Vegas.

programme.title: Meg Rising
programme.desc: Le plus grand prédateur aquatique de l'histoire, que l'on croyait éteint depuis 2 millions d'années, refait surface. L'armada de navires de guerre modernes envoyés pour le détruire s'avère inefficace.

programme.title: Meg Rising 2
programme.desc: De nouveaux requins titanesques et leurs progénitures reviennent à la charge.

programme.title: Multiverse
programme.desc: Des scientifiques rencontrent leurs doubles dunivers parallèles, provoquant rivalités et luttes pour survivre.

Un père de famille en difficulté découvre un salon caché qui offre une solution…les sexbots.

programme.desc: 1882, dans une île au sud de la Nouvelle-Zélande, une mère se lance sur les traces du meurtrier de son mari, responsable de l'enlèvement de son fils.

programme.title: Badland
programme.desc: Le détective Matthias Breecher est engagé pour traquer les pires criminels de guerre confédérés.

programme.desc: Alcatraz vient de rouvrir. C'est aujourd'hui une prison de très haute sécurité, bénéficiant des toutes dernières techniques de surveillance. Alors que Sascha, un agent du FBI, s'y trouve enfermé pour une mission secrète, un commando prend d'assaut le célèbre pénitencier afin de faire libérer Lester, un détenu condamné à mort.

programme.title: Les Larmes Du Soleil
programme.desc: Au Nigéria, la famille du Président vient d'être assassinée et une guerre civile est sur le point d'éclater. Un commando secret mené par le lieutenant Waters est envoyé aux confins de la jungle afin de faire évacuer Lena Kendriks, une femme médecin travaillant pour une organisation humanitaire, d'un village menacé par les rebelles. Mais le cours de la mission change lorsque celle-ci refuse de partir sans les villageois...

programme.title: Xxx Triple X
programme.desc: Après une série de tests, Xander 'XXX' Cage, un spécialiste des sports extrêmes couvert de tatouages, est recruté par Augustus Gibbons, un agent de la NSA, pour s'infiltrer dans une organisation criminelle et mettre fin à ses agissements. Dirigée par un certain Yorgi, celle-ci se fait appeler 'Anarchie 99' et son siège se situe à Prague, en République tchèque.

programme.title: Total Recall Mémoires Programmées
programme.desc: Modeste ouvrier, Douglas Quaid rêve de s'évader de sa vie frustrante. L'implantation de souvenirs que propose la société Rekall lui paraît l'échappatoire idéale. S'offrir des souvenirs d'agent secret serait parfait… Mais lorsque la procédure d'implantation tourne mal, Quaid se retrouve traqué par la police. Il ne peut plus faire confiance à personne, sauf peut-être à une inconnue qui travaille pour une mystérieuse résistance clandestine. Très vite, la frontière entre l'imagination et la réalité se brouille. Qui est réellement Quaid, et quel est son destin ?

programme.title: Le Dernier Combat
programme.desc: Hanté par un passé tragique, un boxeur n'ayant jamais perdu un combat, Sailor O'Connor est un homme abattu. Un coup de chance extraordinaire le fait remonter sur le ring.

programme.title: White Bird
programme.desc: Kat Connors a 17 ans lorsque sa mère disparaît sans laisser de trace. Alors qu'elle découvre au même moment sa sexualité, Kat semble à peine troublée par cette absence et ne paraît pas en vouloir à son père, un homme effacé.

programme.title: OVNI: Sur la piste extraterrestre

programme.desc: Adapté du livre de son fils Tonino, le film retrace la vie de Ferruccio Lamborghini, le célèbre créateur de la marque automobile éponyme.

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.3
programme.desc: After making a secret deal with the Company Commander, Kang Chan-seok returns to the same barracks as Kim Dong-woo, leaving everyone in utter shock. Meanwhile, the Commander reviews the company's unrealistic "Elite Warrior" statistics and decides to personally oversee the selection process to weed out the frauds. Starting now, all personnel who haven't earned the "Elite Warrior" title are restricted from taking leave?!

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.4
programme.desc: The members of the 3rd Squad are holding a "welcome back" party for Kang Chan-seok. The festive mood is short-lived, however, when the youngest recruit accidentally spills ramen broth all over Chan-seok while cleaning up. As everyone freezes in terror, remembering his notorious past as a "demon senior," Chan-seok defies expectations by simply laughing it off. With everyone still feeling uneasy, they head into CBRN and obstacle training—only to find the 2nd Company Commander standing there as the lead instructor.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.5
programme.desc: The grueling CBRN and obstacle training has finally begun. Under the commander's ruthless leadership, a string of dropouts occurs as harsh weather conditions push the soldiers to their breaking point. To make matters worse, the instructor waiting for those who fell behind during the drills... is Min-seok's own sister?! Just as Min-seok barely manages to finish the exercises and catches his breath, he realizes the gas regulator is missing from his rifle. The ordeal never ends—if he doesn't find that regulator, he's headed straight for the stockade.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.6
programme.desc: Min-seok and the company members have soldiered through the grueling CBRN and MacTower drills. During their final mission—the ruck march back to the unit—they share an unforgettable moment of military brotherhood. However, the sentimentality is short-lived as Il-gu, whose back pain worsened during training, is rushed to the hospital. Meanwhile, the Company Commander finds a note tucked away in his office. Crammed onto that single piece of paper is a detailed list of internal abuses and hazing involving the entire unit.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.7
programme.desc: Completely unaware of the storm the worst-ever grievance letter is about to trigger, the company members feel only relief that their training is finally over. While Min-seok is overjoyed at the news of a company dinner, the Commander's expression remains grimly determined as he prepares to report to the Battalion Commander. Meanwhile, due to his worsening back pain, Il-gu is ordered to stay in the hospital for an extra day. However, the ward is filled with bizarre patients, making the hospital feel even less comfortable than the barracks.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.8
programme.desc: Il-gu prepares to return to the unit as his discharge from the hospital approaches. However, instead of a warm welcome from his comrades, he is met with the sight of senior enlisted men—corporals and sergeants—crammed into the multi-purpose room, busy writing statements. Brushing it off at first, Il-gu happens to pass by the administrative office and freezes in his tracks after spotting a single sheet of paper. It is a disciplinary list, and it contains the names of nearly every corporal and sergeant in the entire unit.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.9
programme.desc: Following the massive disciplinary fallout triggered by the grievance letter, the senior corporals and sergeants begin to give the lower-ranking privates the silent treatment, treating them like ghosts. Under Cha Hoon's orders, Noh Hee-jeong attempts to steal the letter from the Commander's office, only to be caught red-handed. Suspecting Dong-woo—who has a history of writing grievance letters—Cha Hoon threatens him to find the real culprit within twenty-four hours. Under immense psychological pressure, Dong-woo's eyes fixate on a target: none other than Min-seok.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.10
programme.desc: The atmosphere of the 2nd Company spirals toward a total breakdown due to the bitter hostility between the seniors and juniors. Pushed to his limit by the stress of desperately searching for the culprit, Dong-woo begins to drive his successors with increasing aggression and violence. Watching Dong-woo's descent with a heavy heart, Min-seok finally reveals a shocking truth: he saw Chan-seok slipping a piece of paper into the Company Commander's office.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.11
programme.desc: While the unit is still in turmoil over the grievance letter, the Company Commander exposes the truth behind it in front of all personnel. Finding the Commander's words hard to accept, Cha Hoon argues back on behalf of the senior soldiers, but the Commander—claiming they show no signs of remorse—orders every corporal and sergeant to assemble on the parade ground. Just as everyone is reluctantly bracing for a mass punishment, the First Sergeant steps in to block the Commander's path.

programme.title: New Recruit Season.2 Ep.12
programme.desc: The Company Commander goes on a rampage following his friction with the First Sergeant. Before long, he issues an absurd order for all soldiers to remain in full battle rattle, including full camouflage face paint, during all daily duties and rest periods. Meanwhile, while on sentry duty, Min-seok and Dong-woo spot a military jeep pulling into the unit. The person stepping out of the vehicle is... the Regimental Commander?!

programme.title: Crocodile Kingdom
programme.desc: The crocodile is king of the wetland a tone of cold blooded monster with the most terrifying bite force on Earth. The product of a 100 million year ancestry, the 25 species around today are testament to the crocodile's supreme intelligence and adaptability.

programme.title: Hidden Japan
programme.desc: Japan is the fourth largest island nation in the world and the second most populous. The culture of Japan is incredible, but even this is overshadowed by nature's beauty. There are more than 130 mammals and an astonishing 600 bird species dwelling in Japan's 6,852 islands. This island chain is so long that it spans several climate zones, providing a huge range of habitat for wildlife. Look beyond the ancient temples and glass skyscrapers and volcanos loom, bears hunt and birds do battle. This is the hidden Japan.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: The Pull of the Wild
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, snakes have fostered our fascination, playing a significant role in our most ancient stories. Follow environmental photojournalist Aaron Gekoski as he investigates our relationship with one of the planet's most popular exotic pets: ball pythons. Traversing four continents, he witnesses sacred rituals, visits voodoo markets and joins expeditions into remote West Africa to discover how ball pythons make their way into the homes of pet owners, worldwide.

programme.title: Meet The Marsupials
programme.desc: Few countries have a more iconic representative in the animal kingdom than Australia and the marsupial. Marsupials were once found across the planet, but over time they found their way to the outback, leaving Australia as an ark carrying the future of pouch mammals. As varied as they are unusual, marsupials are a weird and wonderful mob of animals who carry their young in a pouch. Whether hopping, climbing or even airborne, marsupials are some of the strangest but most fascinating creatures you're likely to meet.

programme.title: Rainforest Home
programme.desc: Rainforest, teeming with millions of dramatic plants and animals, home to some of the most astonishing animal families you're likely to find.

programme.title: Masked Bandits
programme.desc: The masked bandits come with a reputation for trouble and mischief, and while they're certainly cunning and creative, they're also social, loyal and cuddly! From red pandas and badgers to coatis and, of course, raccoons – we'll cast any animal with a stripe across their eyes as pesky troublemakers. Take a moment to look past their robber masks and you'll find a remarkable set of creatures with stories you'll find nowhere else in the animal kingdom. It's time to lift the veil on the masked bandits!

programme.title: Wild Pacific
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia
programme.desc: On the wild coast of Patagonia, the nature calendar describes the most diverse visiting times of fascinating animals, from the southern right whale and other large whales, via the sea lions and elephant seals up to the orcas and millions of penguins. The encounters with whales and their babies are spectacular. Hardly anywhere else on earth can one experience both the brutal and the delightful sides of nature so vividly and so close. The trip to the hot spots for animal watchers and researchers leads us inter alia to the Caleta Valdez. This is where, during the mating season, the southern elephant seals bring their babies into the world, mate and enjoy a little sunbathing on the beach.

programme.title: Lobsters
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Mantises
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to all environments.

programme.title: Vicious Beauties
programme.sub-title: The secret World of the Jelly Fish
programme.desc: Watching the graceful movement of these gelatinous animals is almost hypnotic. Although their bodies are 98% water, jellyfish are deceptively clever and dangerous. But where do these primordial creatures come from? How do they reproduce and how long do they live?

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany are world famous, thanks to the fairy tales of the Brothers Grimm. The strange creatures that actually live there are shown in the episode Forests of the four-part series Wild Germany. A lynx out hunting, red deer stags roar to call their harems together, wild boar forage in dead leaves looking for nuts. When one considers how densely populated it is, Germany is home to a surprising number of different species. Around one third of the country is covered in forest. Forests enters a world full of magic and shows the secretive inhabitants you won't see when out for a walk. Spring in the Black Forest brings out the cherry blossom. Not long now, and the fruit used to make the famous Black Forest Gâteau will appear. A doe has deposited its fawn in the high grass under the trees. Nearby, a vixen is on the look-out for food for her cubs. She would just about be able to handle the fawn ... Life in the forest is full of drama. Humans are rarely seen, the animal adventures take place behind a thick curtain of leaves. The wildcat and the lynx have managed to reconquer some regions from which they had long disappeared. For rare animals like black stork and stag beetle, the woods offer a last refuge. The best nature film-makers in Germany spent more than five years travelling the country from the Harz mountains to the Bavarian Forest, from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, collecting material on the secret lives of forest dwellers.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Potatoes are one of the crops most essential in Korean cuisine. It can be cooked and enjoyed in various ways and depending on each season, as in the form of a simple side dish, soup, or entree. We give you two different versions of potato pancake recipes, either serving as a perfect snack to munch on for adults enjoying a glass of drink or as an afternoon snack for children.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Yaksik has been long-adored as Korea's traditional snack made with glutinous rice mixed with various ingredients like chestnuts, pine nuts, and jujubes. Because isn't too overloaded with strong flavors, it is regarded even as a great meal replacement for people craving something light. Known for its chewy texture and sweet taste, it is commonly served at festivities.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Because many of the potato dishes that we enjoy are either steamed or pan-fried, they boast a rather smooth texture. But Gamja Ongshimi, a local dish that originated in Korea's Gangwon-do Province, is known for the chewiness that fills the whole mouth, as it consists of small rice-cake-shaped balls made with finely-shredded potatoes. Here's a recipe for gamja ongshimi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mackerel is one of the most popular blue-backed fish rich in nutrients. While it's great to be enjoyed as it is, it's also great to braise it with sweet radish using a sweet and spicy marinade. That way, the fishy smell can be easily removed while becoming more flavorful. Here's a recipe for braised mackerel with radish that will get you easily devouring a bowl of rice.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gamja Gang Doenjang Ssambap is one of the most common dishes that Koreans enjoy as a meal. While freshwater snails are primarily used in making the soupy dish, the mollusks can be replaced with potatoes for a softer and more savory taste. We give you a thorough recipe for Gamja Gang Doenjang Ssambap made with fresh potatoes harvested this autumn.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: March 1st this year marks the 104th anniversary of the nationwide movement to restore Korea's independence during Japan's colonial rule. It's the day we all remember and honor countless independence activists who had put their lives on the line for the nation's liberation. Here are the two dishes that relieved their hunger amid the difficult and unsettling times.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Tteokgalbi boasts a long tradition and history from when it was first made in the kitchens of royal palaces to the present day, where it is commonly enjoyed by many people in the nation. Known for its sweet and savory flavor, many people misunderstand it as a quite challenging dish to make themselves. Here's a simple and quick recipe to make tasty tteokgalbi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: One of the best ways to enjoy pollack in the cold winter is by eating it after repeated freezing and thawing the fish. As the fish undergoes this process, it becomes soft and flavorful, which is why many people love to have it as part of their meals. Here's a way to reinvigorate your appetite with grilled dried pollack!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jeyukbokkeum is one of the most common Korean pork dishes that are stir-fried with a spicy sauce made with chili powder and paste. Especially popular among those who are fond of enjoying spicy foods, where and how does the dish attain its unique fire flavors? Here's a recipe for jeyukbokkeum that will get your taste buds addicted to its spiciness.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gimjang season is an important time that comes around every November as families get together to make kimchi at home. Suyuk is a dish commonly enjoyed alongside the kimchi just made on the day of gimjang. It's sliced pork, usually made with pork belly after fully cooked in boiling water. The soft texture of the meat goes superbly well with the crunchiness of the fresh and refreshing kimchi!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Baekseolgi is a steamed rice cake made that boasts a chewy texture. The white color of the rice cake is emblematic of pure and clean food, making it a proper dish to be served on a child's 100th day after birth. The non-glutinous rice powder is used to make a chewy and savory rice cake. Here's a recipe to make baekseolgi at home!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Donkatsu is a dish that is widely enjoyed by just about everyone! The Korean version of donkatsu, in particular, which comes in the flatter and thinner version of pork battered in flour, is casually eaten at home and in restaurants. Having been introduced originally from Japan, let's check out how to make the Korean pork cutlet with its unique taste and shape.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mandu is a juicy little bag of goodness filled with ground meat and chopped vegetables, symbolizing good fortune for its look! They are also high in nutrition and full of meat and vegetables. Here's how to make mandu that cannot be missed out on holiday!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Every Korean's favorite side dish, jangjorim. While it's commonly made with beef, it's also delicious when made with pork with a chewy texture! Here's a recipe that will help you easily make pork jangjorim.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gimbap is a colorful bite of delicious ingredients wrapped and rolled in a sheet of laver! It's considered a convenient dish that can be enjoyed on the go that's also rich in nutrition from vegetables and seaweed. Here's an easy recipe to make one yourself!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gujung ttteokboki was traditionally enjoyed by the kings during the Joseon Dynasty! Contrary to normal tteokboki smothered in red chili paste, it is based on soy sauce, which gives its distinctive sweet and savory taste. It's also high in nutritious values, making it a perfect option for a meal. Here's how to easily make gungjung tteokboki that everyone would love!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Mulhoe is a common dish full of seafood that many people love regardless of the season! It has a sweet, tangy, and savory medley of flavors and textures in a bowl full of cold broth. Here's how to make one yourself at home with ease.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gyeranmari is an egg omelet roll pan-fried with various ingredients! It's one of the most casually enjoyed side dishes by Koreans. Learn the recipe to make one yourself, using the ingredients of your choice!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Cod is one of the best kinds of fish to enjoy during the wintertime. It can be made into a hearty soup that warms you up with its flavorful broth and chewy meat. Here's a recipe for the cod fish soup that will help you get through the blistering cold.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: There's nothing like an icy cold beer on a hot summer day. Pair it with sausage yachae bokkeum, stir-fried sausages and vegetables and dakgangjeong, crispy fried chicken tossed in a sweet and spicy sauce.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: It's a universal custom to enjoy delicious traditional dishes and wish for wellness and good fortune on New Year's day. In Korea, people enjoy tteokguk to wish for longevity and wealth. Marking New Year's, a new chef tells us a recipe to make tteokguk.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Galbijjim is one of the go-to dishes for family gatherings or celebrations! Whether it be made with beef ribs or pork ribs, the dish boasts a uniquely sweet flavor from the soy sauce-based marinade and a tender texture! Here's a recipe for a delicious pork galbijjim that will get you to kickstart the new year on a strong note!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Jeon is one of the staples that make Korean holidays complete. From the zucchini pancakes made with zucchini slices battered in flour and egg to soft and nutty dongtae jeon made with frozen pollock fillets, and last but not least, the colorful and tasty pancake skewers, here are all the easy recipes to make these for this new year!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: The first two K-food recipes Chef Ryan will share with us are bossam and geotjeori, or thinly sliced boiled pork wrapped in napa cabbage leaves with freshly made kimchi. Learn how to make the soft and juicy pork meat infused with fresh aromatics and refreshing tangy kimchi.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Kimchi can add a spicy kick to the original Mexican quesadilla recipe. Kimchi quesadilla offers a flavor-packed blend of tangy kimchi and rich cheese. Pair it with a warm salad made with sweet and soft small napa cabbage and savory bacon bits for a fusion brunch.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: A tofu steak is a great recipe to incorporate vegetables into children's diet. Made from a variety of vegetables and tofu, the dish both satisfies children's picky palates and provides the nutrition they need. Try crispy sweet potato sticks for a healthy and delicious dessert.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Street toast can be easily seen at food stands located near either a subway station or a bus stop! Filled with various ingredients, including eggs, cabbages, cheese, and others between two slices of toasted bread, it's both filling and satisfying to have as a meal or a snack! Here's how to make K-toast which has apparently become a very popular item in the UK!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Chuseok is one of the biggest holidays in Korea when families gather around to celebrate the good harvest with special food. One of the Chuseok staples is songpyeon which is a half-moon shaped steamed rice cake stuffed with various fillings, such as soybeans, sesame seeds and chestnuts. Another dessert to enjoy on Chuseok is nut gangjeong, packed with walnuts, pine nuts and dried dates.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Steamed egg can never be left out when it comes to egg dishes! Boiling in a ttukbaegi, the steamed egg stays warm for a long time. Good as a side dish or with drinks, steamed egg has a wonderful moist and soft texture! Check out the recipe for steamed egg, loved by people of all ages!

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: In Korea, there is nothing like haemul pajeon, or seafood green onion pancake, on a rainy day. Chef Ryan shares with us how to make this delicious pancake made from a flour-based batter with green onions and a variety of seafood. Pair it with a dipping sauce made with dallae (wild mountain chives), dill or any other fresh spring herb available in your area.

programme.title: The Pranks

programme.title: New Girl in Town
programme.desc: When the World Petacular comes to Heartlake City and is almost ruined before it's even started, five feisty girls unite, despite their differences, using their creativity to save the day. Best friends Olivia, Andrea, Emma, Mia and Stephanie reside in HeartLake City but didn't know each other - that is until the World Petacular brought them together! On the eve of the biggest event Heartlake City hosts, disaster and chaos is abound. New-in-town Olivia is helping her veterinarian Aunt Sophie with her mobile clinic. But when she's put in charge of training a scruffy puppy named Scarlet, the puppy runs amuck, leaving a trail of destruction as she collides with Andrea, ruins Emma's banner and Stephanie's cakes, and finally spooks Mia's horse Bella who bucks Mia off and sprints away. The girls quickly unite, helping each-other to save the day and most importantly have fun along the way!

programme.title: Stephanie's Surprise Party
programme.desc: When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they soon discover that it's not easy keeping their plans secret from Stephanie who becomes suspicious when none of the girls have time to hang out. When Emma, Olivia, Andrea and Mia plan a surprise party for Stephanie's birthday, they discover that it's not easy keeping their plans a secret. As the girls choreograph a dance routine, magic show and search for the perfect present and cake, Stephanie becomes aware that her friends are avoiding her on her birthday and excluding her from their activities... Little does she know that her friends are secretly preparing a surprise pool party for her! Once the surprise is revealed Stephanie realises how much her friends care about her and the importance of friendship.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.
